DFS strategy visits pages in depth-first order

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'crawl_strategy' => 'dfs', 'max_concurrent' => 1, 'max_depth' => 2 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
puts result.pages[1].url.inspect
puts result.pages[2].url.inspect
puts result.pages[3].url.inspect
puts result.pages[4].url.inspect
```
